title: Profit model and constraints
goal: A profit model per product and category, so campaign targets are set against break-even ROAS instead of revenue.
scope: Add order costs to the profit model

acceptance_criteria.text: Every product in the sales export has a cost from the COGS source, or is listed as missing.
Break-even ROAS per category matches the client's stated values within 0.1, or the difference is explained.
Order costs (shipping, returns, payment fees) are applied per order as the client described.
No recommendation pushes a product or category the client excluded.

risks: COGS lives in a store metafield; products without it would understate cost.

title: Tools, feed and tracking requirements
goal: A checked map of how product, cost and conversion data move between the store, feed tool, Merchant Center and GA4, with risks flagged.
scope: Document data-flow map and flag risks

acceptance_criteria.text: The data-flow map lists every source -> destination -> data -> frequency the client named.
The feed review covers every Merchant Center account the client lists.
The conversion value definition is checked against the agreed profit definition.

inputs_needed_from_client.question: Invite our address to every Google Merchant Center account. Which accounts exist?
Is product cost (COGS) filled in for all products in your store? List the custom labels used in the feed.

risks: Feed review can't start until Merchant Center access is granted.
